tutor_message.content: A key concept for this problem is thinking about how the “prefix averages” influence the minimum possible maximum value you can achieve. Each operation allows you to shift at most one unit from the right to the left per step, so the numbers on the left can only increase as much as the total sum up to that index allows. Consider how the largest prefix average restricts how low you can make the max value.
